title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
706 Duke Street • Alexandria, V A 22314
202.742.8900 • www.clementmurphy.com
July 8, 2025
Via Electronic Filing

Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
1 First Street, N.E.
Washington, DC 20543-0001




Re: Chevron USA Inc., et al. v. Plaquemines Parish, et al., No. 24-813
Dear Mr. Harris:
I represent Petitioners in the above-captione d case.  Having conferred with Respondents’
counsel, we write jointly to request that the Court enter the following briefing schedule:
Petitioners’ brief and joint appendix:   September 4, 2025
Respondents’ brief: November 13, 2025
Petitioners’ reply: December 15, 2025
These extensions of time are requested to a ccommodate professional and personal obligations
during the briefing period.  Thank you for your consideration.
Sincerely,
Paul D. Clement
Counsel for Petitioners
cc:  All Counsel of Record
